rationale: The Meridian Air flight was canceled for crew availability and the rebooked departure was 19 hours 15 minutes after the scheduled time, which clears the 6-hour Premium waiting period under section 3 of wording 2026.1. The hotel ($245, under the $350 nightly cap for one traveler), meals ($95 with receipts) and airport taxis ($80) are covered extra costs under section 3 and manual section 10, with no deductible on Trip Delay and the total under the $800 Premium maximum. Payout is $420, which is under the $1,000 sign-off limit in manual section 3.
